name: 13-dropouts-24fps-jitter
description: Simulated at 24 fps, 2 px noise, ±8 ms frame-time jitter and random single-joint confidence dropouts (c = 0.15 for one joint in ~2 % of frames). Full (80°, 70°, 75°, 85°), partial (120°, 112°) and borderline (100°) reps. Around the 6th rep (75°) BOTH wrists are hidden (c = 0.1, like hands lost in low light): depth then comes from the shoulders against the frozen hand line (depthSource "shoulders", hint "handsInView") and the rep still counts. targetReps 30.
